stories.headline: Zuckerberg rejects coordinated AI slowdown
stories.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg says competition and liability give AI labs enough incentive to manage safety individually. He cited Meta's delayed Muse release and use of outside evaluators; rival lab leaders favor coordinated slowing.

stories.headline: Gates says governments lag AI's societal risks
stories.summary: Bill Gates says governments are unprepared for AI-driven job losses, cyber threats and addictive companions, while stressing AI's potential benefits. His foundation plans at least $1 billion over two years to widen access.

stories.headline: Democrats probe funding of Trump Jr. parties
stories.summary: Congressional Democrats opened an inquiry into a Russian oligarch's reported payment for two post-wedding parties. Bettina Trump calls it a generous gift; the oligarch and House committee's Republican chair did not comment.

stories.headline: Russian drones hit Ukrainian bus and train
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials say a drone hit a passenger bus near Nikopol, killing five and injuring seven; 168 people evacuated an attacked train without injury. Reuters had not verified one aftermath image; Russia did not comment.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia intercepts drone south of Mecca
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed a Houthi drone before it entered Mecca's restricted airspace. A Houthi source denied threatening holy sites while the group claimed other recent attacks on Saudi territory.
